preconditions: Fresh owned current-project artifacts, canonical resolved relation identities and native CPython; no approval or atomic snapshot claim.
Owned complete current project artifacts and review records; Core review diagnostics, no effective profile or authentication claim.
steps: Invoke the same trace scope through Python, CLI, structured request and portable distribution.
Compare independently expected node distances, edge directions, depth boundaries, original relation values and complete inventory bindings.
Trap project writes, stdin, entropy, subprocesses and lock acquisition; exercise currentness, writer/journal and invalid-input failures.
Resume actual node/edge work under changing targets; compare independent graph sets and retain honest pending, failure and cancellation states without project writes.
Verify exact Why paths through the same public read boundary, with no project mutation or stale-success fallback.
Resume exact search/path checkpoints, including independently trusted file-backed process restarts; preserve all shortest paths and reject changed graph/cursor data without project mutation.
Query all direct incoming/outgoing neighbours and Appendix J review observations; compare independent groups/reasons/identities and guard currentness and all read-only boundaries.
Compare literal domain facts and explicit absence, preserve affected/review sets across order and cache changes, and reject stale or invalid source data without writes or inferred verification.
Execute all six current-project readers through direct APIs, retained phases, structured requests, isolated CLI and zipapp; compare complete native results and original project inventories.
Use actual read-only modes and write-attempt traps; retain loaded/evaluated state across three tiny measured windows and reject changed sources before completion.
Verify Query OR/AND filters, exact pagination, explicit SRX file binding and unavailable providers; compare pinned Git/local Diff bases and reject foreign or unsupported deltas.

Confirm complete JSON delivery through short-writing destinations and explicit failure on stalled/invalid counts, real Broken Pipe and flush failure; retry returns the full current result with unchanged project inventory.

Bind lexical relative roots/base/filter origins and mutable query options before first work; reject active reentry/cancellation, exercise all six measured boundaries and preserve native full result with unavailable optional observations.
Change real bytes or inventory during Diff capture and require an incomplete conflict with no comparison result.

oracle.requirement_contract: Rendering, Query, Trace, Why, Impact und Diff DÜRFEN NICHT das normative Projektmodell verändern.
oracle.scope: This evidence covers the implemented trace and why commands and their current-project read boundaries; remaining operations in SR-REQ-0117 remain open. 8.e.W implements actual read-only trace through Python, CLI, structured requests and the portable zipapp. Explicit in/out/both and nonnegative depth determine exact visited nodes with minimum distances and traversed relation views. The existing identity frontier and complete current-project relation index preserve stored identities, named inverses, original relation data and final currentness checks. Unknown starts, invalid arguments, active writers, unresolved journals, invalid unreachable sources and changed source bytes cannot become a successful partial answer. Coverage is relation-reference/canonical-storage validation, not full semantic or atomic-snapshot approval. R adds genuine process-local TraceTraversal over a supplied resolved RelationIndex: one node removal or directed edge check per work unit, retaining the frontier and unfinished adjacency across calls. Independent cycle/diamond/multiple-relation oracles, a 513-edge node and a 1301-node chain prove unchanged scope under small or varying targets. Incomplete/failed/closed work cannot publish a result; invalid targets consume no work, and result/state copies own their data. Public trace uses this engine with the existing current-project guards. Inventory/graph/output remain materialized; durable Work, adaptive runtime admission, external delivery and supported-platform/performance acceptance remain open. C moves the unchanged frontier implementation into a private graph module while preserving the public TraceTraversal class name, defining module and docstring through inheritance. The project adapter, all W/R behavior oracles and other product sources remain unchanged. 8.f.W implements actual read-only why through Python, CLI, structured requests and the portable zipapp. An explicit configured trace_depth binds scope; a missing value is a model error, not an invented default. Stored directed edges plus symmetric inverse views define connectivity. Complete current references, canonical storage and protected hierarchies are validated. An iterative predecessor graph and path materialization return all shortest paths separately for every reachable Goal, Need and Source, preserving original identities and inverse flags, exact distances and exact path counts. No early origin, representative sample or soft count target discards promised paths. Current-project preflights and final source/configuration checks remain mandatory. The W baseline materialized index, predecessors and all paths. Coverage is not complete semantic validation or atomic-snapshot approval. R adds WhyTraversal with actual node/edge/path-frame work and canonical data checkpoints retaining both frontiers and the complete path prefix. Restore checks an independently retained trusted SHA-256 before parsing, then a closed contract and all supplied graph identities and stored relation data, including unreachable relations. Native file-backed fresh-process tests prove exact resumption without replaying completed search or materialized paths; an independent Cartesian-product oracle covers 8192 complete shortest paths. Malformed, changed-input, failed and cancelled states cannot publish a result. The public command drives the same producer synchronously with its existing project guards. The pure codec does not perform persistence/fsync, admit Work-v1 continuation or claim bounded total memory. Input validation, sorting, codec and final projection are indivisible; durable Work integration, adaptive runtime, external delivery, profile defaults and platform/performance acceptance remain open. C moves the unchanged predecessor search and iterative path materialization into separate private graph modules. The public WhyTraversal owner, both resumable phases, checkpoint bytes/validation, lifecycle and project adapter retain their existing behavior; all W/R tests remain unchanged. 8.g.W implements actual read-only impact through Python, CLI, structured requests and the portable zipapp. A complete current artifact inventory includes all relation-review history. Every directly stored incoming/outgoing relation is grouped by original type, retaining relation identity, both endpoints, physical direction and neighbour existence. Appendix J observations provide separate unreviewed/current/suspect/invalid groups with affected IDs, exact reasons and selected/matching/historical review IDs. Structural invalid bindings and current rejections remain visible; direct invalid yields exit 1 with a complete result and SRV027/error. Unreviewed/suspect use Core warning defaults; effective profile policy is explicitly not claimed. Malformed inventory/review fields abort rather than publish partial results. Unrelated structural invalidity is outside the direct assessment, but all bytes/membership/configuration remain bound and are rechecked before completion. No normative write, cache, lock, inferred priority, invented verification, authenticated-review claim, full semantic approval or atomic snapshot is added. The W baseline materializes inventory and output. R adds artifact_observations for exactly the start and all direct endpoints. Stored priority and verification_plan_status remain literal values; absent fields and absent artifacts are explicitly missing and unavailable, respectively. Missing targets have no inferred artifact type. Every row declares verification_assessment=not_performed; workflow, text, extensions, waivers and current relation reviews never become a computed verification result. The existing result family and catalog metadata use minor version 1.1.0. Independent oracles cover every allowed priority/workflow value, invalid fields, ordering, passive malformed/stale/symlink caches, corrupt normative sources, concurrent projection changes, ownership, CLI parity and schema closure. All old test files and 9197 old IDs remain unchanged. Remaining report consumers, durable Work, external delivery, effective profiles, alternate bases and platform/performance acceptance remain open; materialized input/output and existing read-only/currentness boundaries remain explicit. C moves the pure review and domain-fact projection into the graph layer and shares the identical deterministic connection grouping between the existing planner direct-impact calculation and the current-project CLI. Planner resolved-input validation and current-project invalid-binding reporting retain their distinct contracts. Public APIs, output versions, selected review identities, absence states, owned results, currentness and allowed side effects remain unchanged. Structural extraction checks bind both old grouping blocks and the unchanged remaining code to the verified Result. All 277 old test files and all 9227 test IDs remain unchanged; selected regression also covers affected target-model, saved-plan, execution, normalization and review-policy behavior. 8.l.W adds Query and Diff public adapters and common process-local loading/evaluation/currentness phases for all six readers. Native complete result payloads agree across direct calls, retained phases and real CLI/portable processes. Read-only modes and write-attempt traps prove no normative model writes. Tiny measured windows retain whole phase scope and CLI drives completion; they do not prove a latency bound. Query binds explicit SRX JSON files and exact total/page semantics; Diff binds pinned Git or explicitly local same-project sources. Late source changes cannot publish the evaluated success. Exact command, schema and runtime-policy inventory assertions are extended only for actually implemented contracts, while preserving existing implemented commands, native behavior and explicit rejection of unavailable commands. Durable Work-v1, fine-grained full reader scheduling, external delivery, effective profile defaults and the 10,000-artifact performance requirement remain open. 8.l.R confirms every accepted segment and final flush of machine output. Short writes retain the entire original document; unconfirmed progress and write/flush failures report I/O failure without appending an alternate result. A native Broken Pipe and exact fresh retry/project inventory checks cover failure delivery. Retained work binds lexical paths and owns mutable query options before loading; file contents remain checked during load and final currentness validation. Active reentry/close is rejected, cancellation exposes no completed result and runtime-boundary errors leave failed work without a published success. Unavailable optional measurements retain full computation. Concurrent local comparison capture changes are conflicts. All 286 pre-existing test files and all 9576 existing test IDs remain unchanged. Materialized data, indivisible phases, durable Work, external delivery, provider and performance/platform limitations remain open.

open_items: Rendering/report consumers, durable Work-v1 and external result delivery remain open.
The three common reader phases remain indivisible and materialize their inputs/results; small fixtures do not establish bounded total memory or the 10,000-artifact performance requirement.
Effective profile defaults, evaluation/verification/release providers, alternate Diff base providers and full supported-platform acceptance remain open.
